_note: Hard ceiling for doom.wasm raw bytes. Enforced by tools/archaeology/size-ledger.mjs (called from tools/run-tests.sh). Raise only with a documented regression investigation in Plans.md. Tighten the ratchet after any sustained size reduction.
doom_wasm_raw_budget_justification: 352 KiB (352 × 1024 = 360,448 B), a round binary multiple of 1 KiB, chosen at the task 14.2d base (31e436a) where the artifact was 356,206 B (347.9 KiB) and headroom was 4,242 B (~1.2%) — enough to absorb normal linker drift without false alarms. Those two figures are that commit's, not the present: the artifact grows with the engine, and quoting a live measurement in prose that nothing checks is how the number here drifted from the number in force. size-ledger.mjs measures the artifact against the budget above on every run; read the headroom from it, not from this sentence.
